# LLM cost table

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run llm:costs -- --write`. Do not edit by hand: change
     the rates in server/src/lib/modelCostTable.ts and regenerate. -->

Every per-token rate the platform bills with, in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. The rates live in [`server/src/lib/modelCostTable.ts`](../server/src/lib/modelCostTable.ts); `modelPricing.ts` derives the lookup and the costing math from them, and `LoggerService.logLLMCall` prices every call through that path.

## Keeping this current

1. Edit the row in `server/src/lib/modelCostTable.ts`.
2. `npm run llm:costs -- --write` to regenerate this file.
3. `npx vitest run server/src/lib/modelCostTable.test.ts`.

A price change is **forward-only**: historical `UsageDeductionLog.platformCostUsd`, `LLMCallLog.cost` and `InterviewSession.costBreakdown` rows are denormalized at write time and are never recomputed.

An admin-saved `rate_card.{env}` row in `AppConfig` deep-merges **over** these constants for the admin rate-card panel, so a stale override there keeps displaying the old rate after a bump — clear the repriced model out of that blob.
